decisions.reason: An online customer portal is low-cost infrastructure that ties into ordering processes and strengthens customer relationships, so it shows no shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search.
The packaging display solution won the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024, a clear signal that it exceeds aspirations and adds reputational value, so dropping it is very unlikely.

The quarter-pallet pegboard display sits in the firm's core display business and has a page of its own, and with only one year of evidence slack in the established business lets the firm carry it while results are still uncertain.
The small counter display is a standard catalogue item that fits the firm's existing production capabilities at low incremental cost, so there is little pressure to drop it.

The large freestanding information display is new and its results are unproven, but it is presented prominently and fits the core display range, so the firm keeps it pending further feedback, though Product A shows such items can be pruned quickly.
